scope: Additional source review after the complete safe-autofix implementation merged in PR1786.
counting_contract: 420 distinct substantive source reviews: 200 autofix quality, 200 types, 20 hook controls. A source review cites actual symbols and a concrete boundary/counterexample with a verdict. It is not a native execution or a repeated test invocation.
status: All requested source reviews completed. This immutable baseline source-review record deliberately preserves its review-time findings and pending-native labels. Implementation, regression checks, native hooks and exact-head CI qualify repairs separately.

quality.review_kind: 200 additional distinct source-quality reviews; new native validation is separately scoped
limitations: These records count substantive source/symbol/fixture review, not repeated searches or historical test runs.
Each complete lens remains pending its required native/runtime/performance validation; five-sample performance measurements were not executed by this review.
The QF-001 private-string public-API witness reproduced four baseline ambiguities and tested a finite proposed guard in memory; source integration and owner/native gates remain separate.

reviews.source_analysis: Fresh native diagnostic codes SARJ049/051/054/434 dispatch to comment-token-owned ranges; SARJ016/089 remain in _comment_fix. The accumulation deletion additionally requires ERROR severity and one exact function body. No assigned manual detector supplies a replacement oracle.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A comment saying 5 seconds beside delay_seconds=10 is deliberately unfixable: numeric agreement is independent of unit spelling.
reviews.required_new_validation: Recheck all five rule examples and retain the mismatched-value/unit near miss.

reviews.source_analysis: Removal begins at the whitespace before the owned comment and ends at its token end, retaining the physical newline. Restated call deletion demands a standalone comment and directly following single-line call. Inline and paragraph paths have distinct ownership checks.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A same-line executable prefix must remain unchanged; a trailing comment cannot be mistaken for a preceding-call restatement.
reviews.required_new_validation: Compare exact LF/CRLF output for inline-unit, preceding-call and accumulation comments.

reviews.source_analysis: Accumulation prose removal proves each paragraph line against one zero-argument named call and requires the initialized collection returned by the same plain function. It does not replace calls or their evaluation order.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Four prose lines above a collection with a different return name fail ownership even when the words look redundant.
reviews.required_new_validation: Retain executable-AST equality for accepted prose and an unchanged mismatched-return case.

reviews.source_analysis: Comment tokens use decoded character columns and physical StringIO lines. Shared _autofix restricts nonphysical separators and bare CR to the alias owner, so these builders never mix splitlines diagnostic coordinates with arbitrary Unicode separators.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A U+2028 inside quoted text preceding a banner must not redirect the banner diagnostic onto executable source.
reviews.required_new_validation: Use test_autofix_source_lines nonphysical-separator matrix and add non-BMP before an inline-unit comment.

reviews.source_analysis: Comment edits are returned as groups and reconciled by _coherent_edits; duplicate identical edits collapse before application. A restated comment and banner at nearby lines cannot reuse offsets after stepdown because the next loop regenerates diagnostics.
reviews.concrete_boundary: The existing interacting-fixes fixture combines a banner, stepdown and unused marker; ordering must converge after line relocation.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run selected and configured variants of test_interacting_fixes_reanalyze_locations_after_each_change.

reviews.source_analysis: All comment transformations finish in memory before fix_file creates a temporary, and Standards _plan computes every selected source before its transaction writes. An accumulation group cannot publish only its first deleted comment.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Failing temporary fsync after a whole paragraph was planned must retain the original paragraph and executable body.
reviews.required_new_validation: Pair paragraph source with a later failing file and reuse native writer fsync/rollback failure injection.

reviews.source_analysis: One comment-token and statement index is built per _Source.commentary cache; per-diagnostic _restates_accumulation can revisit a paragraph, while _only_statement is indexed. No performance improvement is claimed from this static analysis.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Many SARJ434 diagnostics in a long paragraph may repeat the paragraph walk, but a single valid body shape bounds accepted work.
reviews.required_new_validation: Measure diagnostic-count and paragraph-length axes independently with five samples before changing caching.

reviews.source_analysis: The implementation keeps independent token ownership, literal-value, numeric-normalization and unit guards. Combining those into a word-only heuristic would lose the equality contract. Manual test-oracle, route, fake and doc metadata findings retain their substantive review requirement.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A boolean numeric value is excluded despite bool being an int subclass; True seconds is not a provable unit narration.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run authored fixed examples for all five selectors and keep boolean/mismatched unit refusals.

reviews.source_analysis: DocstringFixes rederives unconsumed and ERROR-redundant locations from native detectors before accepting section or whole-doc removal. The fix requires a private nested unescaped synchronous owner; manual class/module/inherited docs are outside that proof.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A public function with exactly the same text may be consumed by external help() and cannot inherit the private-function deletion proof.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run all five selected docstring examples plus public/private matched near misses.

reviews.source_analysis: Only an isolated unescaped triple-quoted literal is edited. _literal refuses executable prefixes/suffixes and backslashes; _remove refuses deleting the only body statement or promoting a following string to __doc__.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Removing the first of two consecutive string expressions would promote the second to observable __doc__; current guard prevents that.
reviews.required_new_validation: Verify exact source retention for escaped quotes, semicolon suffix and a following string literal.

reviews.source_analysis: Closure names must be unique direct calls; decorated, yielded, dynamic-namespace and metadata-observed functions are refused. Ancestor callable checks close indirect generator/coroutine frame observation. These are independent guards rather than stylistic conservatism.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Returning _helper or handing it to a reporter makes its docstring externally visible even if the helper starts with underscore.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run external metadata observers and runtime rejected-docstring cases.

reviews.source_analysis: AST UTF-8 columns are decoded before indexing the Unicode source. Section replacement takes native ast.Constant content only after proving no escape spelling, and shared line gates exclude bare CR/nonphysical separator ambiguity.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A non-ASCII identifier before a doc literal must not shift the literal start by byte/character mismatch.
reviews.required_new_validation: Exercise CRLF, Unicode indentation-adjacent names and a no-final-newline triple-quoted literal.

reviews.source_analysis: After a section edit the configured loop must rederive redundancy before any later whole-doc removal. Multiple competing Args/Returns headings are refused because one heading being redundant does not prove another carries no contract.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A doc with both Returns and Yield sections has independent metadata even if one restates the signature.
reviews.required_new_validation: Compare selected Args/Returns/type-label rules with combined configured output and second-pass equality.

reviews.source_analysis: A whole-doc or section edit is one in-memory plan; no write occurs until source parsing/compilation succeeds. The writer snapshots its complete bytes and metadata, and Standards transaction owns multi-file writes.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A source edit during temporary fsync must preserve the concurrently added regression doc text instead of replacing it with the old planned doc.
reviews.required_new_validation: Use test_source_edit_during_temporary_fsync_is_preserved with an accepted private docstring source.

reviews.source_analysis: Unconsumed and redundant native locations are cached per context, avoiding a detector call for every doc diagnostic. private_unescaped_function still scans references and ancestors for each potential owner; this deserves measurement before a shared graph change.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Many tiny nested helpers with metadata readers can make repeated global scans expensive despite all edits being refused.
reviews.required_new_validation: Benchmark helper-count and doc-length separately with exact source digests and five cold/warm samples.

reviews.source_analysis: Type-label removal retains meaningful prose after the colon rather than erasing the whole Args item. The native no-unnecessary-docstring gate remains mandatory for any edit. Extending deletion to class/module or inherited metadata lacks local authority.
reviews.concrete_boundary: UTF-8 JSON; duplicate keys are rejected must survive removing only (str), as the authored no-docstring-type-restatement fixed example shows.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run the fixed typed-prose example and exact post-fix native diagnostics; keep API aliases.

reviews.source_analysis: SARJ034/477 choose separate closed-signature builders; unused/factory keyword edits must match the precise diagnostic argument and independently rerun the detector invariant. Existing dependency-fixture substitution uses a complete source-declared profile rather than broad fixture injection.
reviews.concrete_boundary: An underscored option with an annotation or non-singleton default can execute observable binding code and remains manual.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run selected signature/factory examples and the closed dependency-fixture profile.

reviews.source_analysis: Tokenized nesting determines comma boundaries instead of splitting source text on commas. Commented signatures/calls are refused; retained parts preserve original text and lone-star removal is explicit when the last keyword-only parameter disappears.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A default tuple containing commas cannot create extra signature fields; a trailing rationale comment must prevent lossy reconstruction.
reviews.required_new_validation: Compare exact multiline signatures with nested tuples, tabs and inline comments.

reviews.source_analysis: Every helper reference must resolve to the same function, be a direct call and match its current call signature. The private unescaped/inert scope proof protects metadata, dynamic namespaces and finalizer timing. Removing call arguments is limited to None/bool singleton values.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Dropping _unused=side_effect() would suppress a call; the singleton gate rejects it even if the parameter is never loaded.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run side-effecting option refusals and external frame/signature observers.

reviews.source_analysis: Native AST byte columns are decoded to code points before replacements; token coordinates use the same physical source buffer. Enclosing type parameters are refused so signature edits cannot capture generic names with delayed annotation semantics.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A PEP 695 enclosing type parameter named like the helper invalidates direct-call identity even when a token spells the same name.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run generic shadowing, NFKC names, non-BMP prior text and CRLF cases.

reviews.source_analysis: Keyword-only insertion and every rewritten call are returned as one candidate group, so a conflicting candidate postpones the complete signature conversion. Factory option propagation similarly pairs signature/body/call edits.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Changing the callee to keyword-only while leaving one positional caller untouched breaks invocation; group acceptance must be atomic.
reviews.required_new_validation: Combine keyword-only, unused-option and docstring rules and verify the configured second pass is identical.

reviews.source_analysis: The signature insertion and call edits stay in memory through apply_edits and compile; no native file writer observes an intermediate incompatible signature. Standards capture/CAS applies to the final replacement bytes.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A failure after the plan but before first write must preserve both function and its original positional call.
reviews.required_new_validation: Inject before-write and later-file failure using a closed keyword-only candidate.

reviews.source_analysis: Tokens and provenance are cached per ParameterFixes, but _calls and private-scope closure checks scan file references for each diagnosed function. A source change must invalidate all these facts, which the outer loop accomplishes with a new context.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Thousands of unused keyword diagnostics can repeat function-reference scans even on unchanged bodies.
reviews.required_new_validation: Measure number of closed helpers independently from signature length before proposing indexes.

reviews.source_analysis: The implementation does not invent keyword names: it uses existing parameter AST arguments and preserves evaluation order while moving positional arguments to keywords. General injection/default/precise-factory findings remain manual because they need lifecycle or API intent.
reviews.concrete_boundary: The authored no-unused-underscored example removes only an unused boolean from an enclosed helper and its proven callers.
reviews.required_new_validation: Verify actual fixed examples versus conditional SAFE catalog metadata and keep empty selected-rule behavior.

reviews.source_analysis: Mapping[Any] replacement requires the actual SARJ447 annotation location, imported Mapping/Any and an unused closed private parameter. Existing Self/domain/precise-return builders use separate native diagnostics; the manual model/router/schema frontiers need explicit domain contracts.
reviews.concrete_boundary: dict[str, Any] or a used Mapping parameter cannot inherit the unused Mapping argument proof.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run selected mapping example with used, mutable and foreign-import near misses.

reviews.source_analysis: Only the Any expression span is replaced; physical newlines within that span are retained. The description owner rebuilds a call only through its comment refusal helper, while Self replacement refuses comments spanning the annotation.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A multiline qualified Any expression must not collapse unrelated source lines or discard an attached directive.
reviews.required_new_validation: Exercise multiline qualified typing.Any with CRLF and an adjacent comment refusal.

reviews.source_analysis: Provenance verifies module-owned imports rather than names; object must be unshadowed in every recorded scope and its builtin namespace untouched. Retaining another Any import use prevents creating an unused-import formatter side effect.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A local Any = object or shadowed object binding destroys the promised type identity despite familiar spelling.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run import-alias, builtin mutation and matching unused/used parameter fixtures.

reviews.source_analysis: Both direct name uses and string spelling references inside the helper block the edit, preventing quoted annotations or metadata-like string consumers from observing a changed contract. _replace decodes byte columns.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A quoted annotation containing the unused argument name still observes its contract and must refuse the change.
reviews.required_new_validation: Use quoted-annotation observer fixtures plus non-BMP text before the annotation.

reviews.source_analysis: The fixer deliberately requires another resolved Any import use, so annotation narrowing cannot automatically trigger import removal and alias binding changes. Outer configured iterations rebuild provenance after any neighboring doc/signature edit.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Two candidate parameters can be each other's last Any use; after the first change the next iteration must reevaluate ownership.
reviews.required_new_validation: Probe two unused Mapping[Any] parameters under selected and full rule sets and assert import/use convergence.

reviews.source_analysis: Annotation changes produce a single final source replacement through the shared writer; failures cannot publish only part of a qualified type span. Standards plans annotation and non-Python edits before transaction ownership begins.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A later SQL planning error after an accepted Python annotation candidate must precede any Python write.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run selected multi-engine plan failure with accepted mapping input and malformed SQL.

reviews.source_analysis: Whole-file binding checks and reference scans run for each annotation diagnostic; provenance and parameters are cached on the owner, while source lines are rebuilt in _replace. This is a measurable optimization target, not evidence of a regression.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Large files with many unused Mapping annotations and many object bindings can repeatedly scan the same immutable provenance table.
reviews.required_new_validation: Benchmark annotation-count and file-size axes with exact environment/input and five samples.

reviews.source_analysis: The narrow proof is intentionally stronger than syntactic Mapping-to-object replacement: unused, closed, default-free, uncommented owners plus retained imported names. General schema/model/nominal contract alternatives require consumer decisions documented in manual-frontier receipts.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A meaningful default or a string reference makes a parameter contract observable even when no Name load appears.
reviews.required_new_validation: Reconcile all five cohort SAFE examples against their actual builders and run exact native selectors.

reviews.source_analysis: AsyncMock await-oracle addition is delegated to a canonical, comment-free three-statement test profile. Xfail strictness, dead mock configuration, literal markers and unused file escape-hatch removal each retain their native diagnostic gate.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A call assertion without a matching await is not enough to invent an awaited-call oracle.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run canonical AsyncMock await positive and nonawaited/mismatched-literal refusals.

reviews.source_analysis: Call reconstruction refuses comments across the complete call. Marker deletion uses a full standalone statement span and inserts pass for the otherwise empty literal-marker body; this preserves syntax without touching unrelated suite lines.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Deleting the only _=1 body statement without pass would create an empty suite.
reviews.required_new_validation: Verify exact output for one and several marker assignments plus commented Mock/xfail calls.

reviews.source_analysis: Dead Mock configuration removal is authorized by a fresh native diagnostic and only strips the named dead return_value/side_effect keyword. AsyncMock testing separately requires canonical imports and no namespace patching, while xfail checks existing strict and unpacked keyword ownership.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A side_effect expression with runtime effects cannot be removed merely because another assignment follows; the detector must establish inertness.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run effectful dead-configuration near misses and shadowed AsyncMock/pytest providers.

reviews.source_analysis: Marker values are restricted to primitive constants and all offsets pass through the byte-aware _Source span. The AsyncMock added assertion computes its insertion after the full physical line and handles a missing final newline explicitly.
reviews.concrete_boundary: An EOF assertion needs a leading newline before inserting assert_awaited_once, while non-BMP literal arguments must not shift its end.
reviews.required_new_validation: Exercise canonical await assertion at EOF, CRLF and Unicode literal arguments.

reviews.source_analysis: Xfail does not change parametrized decorator stacks because per-case marks may own strictness. Added await assertions keep the original call assertion, so call and await contracts both remain checked. Whole-config reanalysis must stop after the new oracle resolves SARJ456.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A parametrized xfail with per-case strict=False cannot inherit function-level strict=True without review.
reviews.required_new_validation: Compare selected/full xfail and async assertion output, then rerun both rules for idempotence.

reviews.source_analysis: The final test source compiles before fix_file writes, and a candidate group cannot publish half an inserted assertion. Standards transaction preserves a different concurrent source rather than restoring a stale test during rollback.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Fail after writing one test file while another concurrent test edit appears: rollback must restore only owned replacement bytes.
reviews.required_new_validation: Reuse source-write rollback ownership tests with marker and AsyncMock files.

reviews.source_analysis: All five builders run from native diagnostics, but _testing_fix rescans imports/comments per await finding and markers scan assignments per diagnostic. Static complexity suggests a future per-context index only after measuring unchanged/refused profiles.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Many almost-canonical async tests with one unknown import repeatedly traverse the same import list.
reviews.required_new_validation: Measure diagnostic count versus source size separately; do not call this a measured regression.

reviews.source_analysis: The literal-marker proof and pass insertion are smaller than a general dead-store optimizer. Broader suppression, spec, copy, cleanup and test-oracle repairs require the explicit contracts in the manual receipt. Conditional SAFE must not imply every diagnostic is fixable.
reviews.concrete_boundary: _ = lease() remains because deleting it would change cleanup/finalizer timing.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run authored positive and effectful-marker examples with actual native selected APIs.

reviews.source_analysis: Delete removal accepts only an argument-free closed helper assigning None, deleting that same name and returning a constant. Duplicate exports use exact diagnostic element locations; alias and repeated-literal owners rederive native finding locations.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Deleting an arbitrary object can run a finalizer and cannot use the None-local subset.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run None deletion positive, object finalizer refusal and alias/export selected native cases.

reviews.source_analysis: Export rebuilding preserves tuple protocol by retaining a comma for a singleton. Comments and __all__.insert cause refusal. Stepdown refuses adjacent comment ownership, defaults, decorators and annotations rather than moving definition-time effects.
reviews.concrete_boundary: ("one",) must stay a tuple after duplicate removal; ("one") changes wildcard export iteration.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run singleton tuple protocol and comment-protected export/stepdown fixtures.

reviews.source_analysis: Stepdown moves only inert definitions across other inert definitions before one caller. Local alias elimination requires a closed private function, builtin dict and raw NFKC-verified names. Repeated literals reuse an already shared stable binding only in builtin len calls.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Extracting an arbitrary equal string can change object identity, interning and lifetime; len-only use avoids those observers.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run runtime alias/finalizer tests and repeated-literal identity near misses.

reviews.source_analysis: The alias owner keeps aligned physical-line buffers and validates raw identifier slices against NFKC AST identities. The outer alias bridge applies native fixes first and reconciles them against the original source before returning Unicode TextEdits.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A Kelvin-sign spelling normalizes to K; replacement length must use raw source spelling, not normalized AST identifier length.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run NFKC identifiers across LF/CRLF/bare-CR and nonphysical separator alias fixtures.

reviews.source_analysis: Stepdown contains deletion plus insertion, alias removal pairs assignment/use edits, and repeated literals group all matching uses. Candidate grouping prevents accepting only one binding half; fresh diagnostics handle delayed conflicting edits.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A declaration moved by stepdown changes later literal coordinates, so cached locations from the previous source must never be reused.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run combined stepdown/alias/repeated-literal selectors and configured second-pass equality.

reviews.source_analysis: Source-only planning keeps binding removal and its replacement uses atomic within the transformed string. The shared writer rejects late source/inode changes and Standards rolls back owned cross-file writes; public apply_fixes has a separate same-offset collision probe proposal.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Two public Fix groups inserting different declarations at the same offset currently evade its start<previous overlap check.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run quality witness proposal for ambiguous zero-width public fixes plus native binding-file rollback.

reviews.source_analysis: _coherent_edits uses sorted accepted edits and bisect lookup but Python list insertion still shifts elements. RepeatedLiteralFixes caches detector locations yet rebuilds literal mappings for each diagnostic. This identifies a bounded workload to measure.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Thousands of disjoint literal replacements can make repeated candidate indexing and list insertions dominate parsing.
reviews.required_new_validation: Five cold/warm samples varying literal count independently from file size are required before optimizing.

reviews.source_analysis: The strongest declaration proofs deliberately stay separate: None deletion, inert movement, stable existing string binding and dict keyword aliasing protect different observers. Broader module export/import/helper deduplication has external identity and API boundaries.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Removing __all__ is different from removing a duplicate entry: wildcard exports can change even when duplicates have no effect.
reviews.required_new_validation: Check public diagnostic fix compatibility, source hash refusal and every conditional SAFE example.

reviews.source_analysis: String growth rewriting is restricted to nonempty literal string fragments in a closed private helper. Collection comprehension proves literal scope, fstring conversion exact primitives, regex ownership and literal sets each have independent native finding dispatch.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A generator of user objects cannot be joined under the literal-fragment proof because iterator effects and string coercion differ.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run all five selected positive examples and dynamic iterable refusals.

reviews.source_analysis: Source reconstruction is allowed only when comments across the exact transformed region are absent. Prefix/suffix outside the AST span remain byte-for-byte in the string; tuple-shaped dictionary keys/elements retain their syntax through native AST rendering.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A comment documenting a duplicate-key override inside the literal loop must not disappear in a comprehension.
reviews.required_new_validation: Compare exact untouched prefix/suffix and retained duplicate-key result in the authored collection fixture.

reviews.source_analysis: Fstrings accept str/repr/ascii only for exact primitive results with unshadowed builtins; intersection-to-isdisjoint accepts literal primitive sets. Regex fullmatch needs owned re and a strict-end pattern or a literal no-newline subject.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A str subclass with __format__ or an effectful set element can observe changed dispatch/equality ordering.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run conversion-subclass, mutated builtins and set hash/equality refusals plus regex newline boundaries.

reviews.source_analysis: Regex pattern slices are taken from the native literal after validating the closed pattern grammar; shared byte-aware spans handle Unicode. Nonphysical separators or bare CR route away from these builders.
reviews.concrete_boundary: The dollar anchor may match before a final newline; replacing match(^x$, "x\n") by fullmatch is not equivalent.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run final-newline regex witness, escaped-anchor refusals, Unicode and CRLF exact-output cases.

reviews.source_analysis: A comprehension can remove loop-target leakage; the proof requires literal function scope and a closed returned collection shape. The string-growth edit changes initialization, append and return as one group; configured reanalysis then checks other collection rules.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Removing a loop would otherwise change a later read of its target, so that extra statement must invalidate the closed shape.
reviews.required_new_validation: Probe retained loop-target use and combined concat/comprehension/fstring idempotence.

reviews.source_analysis: Builders produce complete transformed strings and compile before the writer mutates a path. A failed collection plan cannot leave the old return pointing at a newly list-valued string accumulator.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Failure between string-accumulator initialization and join would expose the wrong result type if edits were written separately; grouping prevents this.
reviews.required_new_validation: Inject file failure after a multi-edit concat plan and assert original bytes remain.

reviews.source_analysis: Concat decomposition recurses through nested Add trees; collection ownership scans surrounding functions. Existing parser limits bound accepted syntax, but long left-associated source is a targeted recursion/performance refusal workload.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A very long concat chain can reach recursion limits before yielding a structured refusal.
reviews.required_new_validation: Measure deep concat rejection and many literal collection diagnostics; record exceptions without claiming a pass.

reviews.source_analysis: Literal collection/string proofs avoid a general optimizer and preserve observable user-defined operations. Manual collection models, APIs, route changes and retry settings still lack domain/lifecycle contracts; no new diagnosed subset was proven.
reviews.concrete_boundary: bool is an int subclass but matching literal sets still needs the builtin-only proof; arbitrary object equality remains excluded.
reviews.required_new_validation: Verify all five actual native fixed examples, remaining manual diagnostics and formatter convergence.

reviews.source_analysis: Value/type dispatch edits require a fresh diagnostic at the if root and a closed private parameter subject. Complexity simplification accepts only constant-True chains ending in a constant return; exception merging and assert-never suppression removal retain separate native proofs.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A public subject object can implement effectful equality or metaclass instance checks, invalidating a syntactic if-to-match rewrite.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run closed literal dispatch positives and external-observer runtime refusals.

reviews.source_analysis: Exception merging refuses comments from the first handler through the second body, preserves the first handler text and deletes the second physical span. Complexity flattening retains physical newline count before the surviving leaf rather than shifting unrelated source.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Different handler rationale comments are owned even when AST bodies match.
reviews.required_new_validation: Verify exact comment refusal, CRLF handler output and complexity leaf prefix/suffix preservation.

reviews.source_analysis: Native _dispatch_parameter requires closed calls and a true parameter, refusing global/nonlocal subjects. Exception types must resolve to builtins with no type-parameter capture; assert-never proof requires a stable local StrEnum and exact identity branches.
reviews.concrete_boundary: An imported exception class may have custom __instancecheck__ or be a runtime tuple group, so generalized merging/dispatch remains manual.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run builtin shadowing, custom metaclass and StrEnum alias/mutation near misses.

reviews.source_analysis: Complexity reduction has an explicit depth limit of 32 and requires complete isolated leaf spans. _Source decodes byte columns; generic exception type references are refused. Unsupported line separators never reach these builders.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A 33-level True chain must remain unchanged rather than relying on unbounded recursive simplification.
reviews.required_new_validation: Probe limit-1/limit/limit+1 chains, malformed trees and non-BMP preceding source.

reviews.source_analysis: Dispatch matching preserves branch order and fallback shape. Exception merging can expose a newly adjacent third handler on the next native reanalysis; assert-never does not invent a branch, only removes a proven obsolete argument suppression.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Nonterminal exception refinements can fall through to later independent conditions; an exclusive match cannot replace them.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run three-handler convergence and selected/full branch/exhaustiveness combinations.

reviews.source_analysis: Branch and exception plans compile as a complete source string before write; grouped type tuple replacement plus second-handler deletion cannot be written independently. Standards owns multi-file rollback and refuses stale preimages.
reviews.concrete_boundary: If handler deletion succeeds but tuple replacement does not, exceptions escape; atomic source application prevents that intermediate program.
reviews.required_new_validation: Inject later-file failure with a two-edit exception plan and inspect rollback bytes.

reviews.source_analysis: The constant-True walk is explicitly iterative and depth-bounded; dispatch walks elif chains and ast.unparse reconstructs them, while repeated candidate scans can scale with function count. No timing claim is made.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Thousands of long refusing dispatch chains plus many diagnostics separate scan cost from output rendering.
reviews.required_new_validation: Collect five matching cold/warm samples for chain-depth and diagnostic-count workloads.

reviews.source_analysis: Each simplification is owned by an existing diagnostic and stronger closed-shape proof; no broad dead-code, exception or model rewrite is introduced. Manual database, type narrowing, clock and architecture frontiers retain missing schema/runtime intent explicitly.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Changing TypeIs to TypeGuard is not a cosmetic annotation repair: negative-branch narrowing changes.
reviews.required_new_validation: Verify all five SAFE examples through native check/fix/check plus actual formatter sequence.

reviews.source_analysis: Regex and awaited-None walrus edits require the native diagnostic on the preceding assignment and one matching reference inside the following condition. Stream loops and or-patterns use separate native shape proof; comprehension caching is limited to literal strings and pure builtin transforms.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A condition mentioning the assigned variable twice cannot be rewritten by replacing one occurrence.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run all five selected positives plus duplicate-condition-reference refusals.

reviews.source_analysis: The stream rewrite requires full standalone assignment/guard spans and no comments across loop header through the guard. Or-pattern merging rejects comments throughout both arms; walrus edits retain the exact RHS spelling instead of reconstructing its expression.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A comment between read() and sentinel break owns ordering context and must prevent collapsing those statements.
reviews.required_new_validation: Compare exact LF/CRLF source around stream guard comments and or-pattern rationale comments.

reviews.source_analysis: Comprehension caching permits only literal str transforms or proven builtin len, in a returned closed helper. Stream rewrites preserve one producer evaluation and distinguish truthiness versus None sentinel; or-pattern detector excludes bodies using correlated narrowed captures.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Two identical calls to a mutable callback are not pure merely because AST dumps match; literal str ownership is essential.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run callback effect refusals, builtin len mutation and correlated pattern-binding cases.

reviews.source_analysis: New walrus names are chosen from NFKC-normalized tokenize.NAME tokens, preventing normalized Unicode collisions. _Source AST spans decode UTF-8 byte columns and shared unsupported-line gates precede these builders.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A preexisting normalized spelling such as a compatibility character can occupy a seemingly fresh ASCII cache name.
reviews.required_new_validation: Exercise NFKC collisions, non-BMP preceding text and unsupported separator refusal.

reviews.source_analysis: Comprehension output/condition replacement is one group; stream and statement walrus plans likewise group deletions and insertions. A combined configured run must recompute each diagnostic after the previous group changes source offsets.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A cache name becomes visible in the surrounding scope, so a body with additional statements is excluded rather than assuming harmless leakage.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run combined comprehension/walrus/collection fixes and second-pass equality.

reviews.source_analysis: All grouped walrus and pattern edits apply to an immutable in-memory preimage and compile before path mutation. Standards transaction captures final bytes only, while the native writer compares the source after temporary fsync.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A two-edit walrus plan must not delete the assignment before discovering its condition insertion cannot compile.
reviews.required_new_validation: Inject prewrite failure with a walrus group and verify complete original bytes.

reviews.source_analysis: Fresh-name discovery tokenizes the complete source per accepted comprehension candidate, and matching scans comprehension nodes per diagnostic. _Source caches common tokens/comments but this particular name set is rebuilt.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Many independent literal comprehensions create repeated whole-file token scans even when cache names differ.
reviews.required_new_validation: Measure comprehension count and token count independently with five comparable samples before adding a cache.

reviews.source_analysis: Pattern edits are delegated to the detector's actual mergeable runs, preserving correlated narrowing exclusions. Stronger closure/string proofs apply only to comprehension caching; general API/type/schema/transaction frontiers still require missing intent.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A nested predicate no-escape proof cannot authorize fixing a module-only type-guard diagnostic.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run exact native rule example verification and selected/default compatibility aliases.

reviews.source_analysis: JWT repair is owned by a fresh SARJ504 finding, static provider provenance and literal option structure; Loguru and SQL projection have separate provider/source profiles. Constant-time comparison is delegated to captured canonical hmac/type/bytes bindings.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A user-defined jwt.decode or logger lookalike cannot inherit the provider-specific replacement.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run all five selected positive profiles and aliased/rebound provider refusals.

reviews.source_analysis: Printf repair changes only the message literal, refusing comment-owned message spans; exc_info/JWT call rebuilding refuses all call comments. SQL projection changes only the one star byte inside a single unescaped ASCII query literal.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A concatenated/escaped SQL literal cannot share decoded SQL offsets with raw Python source.
reviews.required_new_validation: Verify exact SQL-star prefix/suffix and log message output under LF/CRLF.

reviews.source_analysis: JWT dictionaries require unique literal string keys and a literal required-claim sequence before adding exp. Loguru format conversion uses primitive values and supported placeholders; security compare insists on exact bytes rather than subclasses, captured imports and a closed forwarding shape.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Duplicate require keys or **options have last-write/expansion semantics that cannot be reconstructed safely.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run duplicate-key/unpacked-options, effectful log arguments and bytes-subclass comparison refusals.

reviews.source_analysis: JWT positional arguments are bounded to the non-options prefix, rejecting starred arguments and generic shadowing. SQL projection separately caps literal query length and source grammar before invoking PostgreSQL parsing; byte/codepoint conversion remains local to each literal owner.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A fourth positional decode argument can already own options, so adding options= would create conflicting binding.
reviews.required_new_validation: Probe positional bound, non-BMP preceding literals, malformed SQL and maximum literal projection widths.

reviews.source_analysis: Loguru exc_info replacement first wraps logger.opt then retains remaining kwargs; printf may need the next configured pass because its receiver shape changes. Native diagnostics determine whether another edit remains supported instead of forcing both rewrites.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A chained logger.opt receiver is not the direct canonical logger profile accepted by every fixer.
reviews.required_new_validation: Compare selected and full Loguru rule sets, confirm second-pass equality and explain remaining manual diagnostics.

reviews.source_analysis: Security/provider edits remain source-only until parse/compile; SQL projection verifies the parsed before/after delta before returning its edit. Standards _plan handles native providers before writing any selected file and restores owned preimages on later write failure.
reviews.concrete_boundary: An invalid SQL projection plan must not leave an unrelated JWT exp edit written when planning a later file fails.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run multi-engine native planning failure and writer rollback using accepted JWT/projection sources.

reviews.source_analysis: Printf conversion scans the template with a closed placeholder regex and exact argument count. SQL projection limits grammar to 2,048 bytes, eight integer values and bounded quoted labels; hmac checks bounded import ancestors but scans source namespace facts.
reviews.concrete_boundary: An enormous or unsupported SQL string should refuse before expensive native parsing, while many format placeholders must scale with template length.
reviews.required_new_validation: Measure bounded SQL refusal and many Loguru diagnostics; no speed claim without five samples.

reviews.source_analysis: Existing list/tuple/set required-claim container kinds are retained. Provider-specific edits do not select trusted origins, redaction fields, schemas or cleanup policy for manual rules. These missing contracts remain explicit and cannot be repaired with dummy values.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Adding a generic log redaction string can destroy the operational oracle without proving approved metadata.
reviews.required_new_validation: Verify actual examples/catalog SAFE parity and exact native fix APIs for all five rules.

reviews.source_analysis: Every comment edit belongs to a live ESLint context.report. Volume rules use jsdocDecorationFix and require the modified prose to clear the detector; member/restated-comment edits use strict owned comment ranges. This does not authorize deleting arbitrary long prose.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A long header whose plus decorations are removed but still exceeds the volume threshold must have no offered automatic fix.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run excessive/no-long authored decoration examples and unchanged over-threshold near misses.

reviews.source_analysis: Automatic comment deletion replaces only non-newline content, keeping physical line endings for line-sensitive tools. ownLineCommentRemovalRange refuses a preceding next-line directive and any executable token beside the comment.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A preceding @ts-expect-error targeting the JSDoc line must not be retargeted onto the following declaration.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run safe-autofix next-line directive and preceding-statement witnesses with CRLF and EOF.

reviews.source_analysis: Member deletion requires exact multiword identifier tokens and excludes negation, modal requirements, conditions and sentinels. JSDoc decoration keeps all prose bytes and refuses licenses, examples, credentials, links and structured literal contexts.
reviews.concrete_boundary: The name cacheUser does not make Does not cache user a restatement: negation is behavior.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run behavioral/negated/name-matched comments and protected JSDoc contexts.

reviews.source_analysis: SourceCode ranges and JavaScript slices both count UTF-16 units. Comment ownership computes physical LF/CRLF boundaries; a bare CR is not independently recognized by this helper and must conservatively refuse when its surrounding whitespace fails the range check.
reviews.concrete_boundary: An emoji before a same-line comment occupies two UTF-16 units; converting the range to code-point indices would corrupt its prefix.
reviews.required_new_validation: Probe non-BMP prefixes, CR-only source, BOM and EOF comments; preserve unsupported input.

reviews.source_analysis: Multiple comment rules may offer identical empty-line-preserving edits; ESLint owns application/reanalysis and conflicting ranges must await another iteration. The shared helper ensures each deletion retains the same line targets across configured prose rules.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Restated JSDoc and long-comment diagnostics can overlap; one pass must not apply offsets from both independently after source shifts.
reviews.required_new_validation: Compare selected/full comment configurations and verifyAndFix second-pass equality.

reviews.source_analysis: These TypeScript fix callbacks are source-only; ESLint controls file writes. Standards run executes ESLint among external formatter commands after native fix_paths, outside the native FileTransaction, so full-pipeline restoration is an explicit pending contract check.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A formatter can write a comment fix and then fail with infrastructure status 2; current run stops subsequent commands without an evident rollback.
reviews.required_new_validation: Inject an external formatter write-then-error in a private fixture and inspect source/status before deciding repair.

reviews.source_analysis: Line-end range searches use indexOf/lastIndexOf per comment; decoration scanning is linear in each comment but volume/member detectors may repeat comment analysis. Existing thousand-binding tests do not measure these prose workloads.
reviews.concrete_boundary: One very long physical line with many comments can repeat forward line scans even when all own-line edits refuse.
reviews.required_new_validation: Measure comment count and line length independently with five cold/warm samples.

reviews.source_analysis: The small shared ownership helper is the right byte-preservation owner; semantic restatement remains in each detector. No trusted origin, query parameter, complexity refactor, sleeper or localization key can be invented for the six manual frontiers.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A threshold-based member comment with novel contract words cannot be promoted to exact-name deletion simply because most neighboring comments repeat names.
reviews.required_new_validation: Verify all five SAFE metadata examples and actual ESLint fixes under selected/default configs.

reviews.source_analysis: Numeric narration removal is gated by equal numeric literal/unit ownership. Type-member walls use exact names; typed-tag removal preserves meaningful continuation/custom tags. no-union-in-comment narrows only existing authored literal branches on an unused private owner.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A comment listing a,b beside plain string has no existing literal-domain authority and remains manual.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run all six selector examples and the existing-literal-union private/public near misses.

reviews.source_analysis: Own-line phase/banner/member edits retain all physical endings, while trailing comments remove only horizontal whitespace through content EOL. Typed JSDoc reconstruction preserves retained tag prose; union narrowing retains its explanatory comment.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Deleting a multi-line JSDoc block next to a directive must not change which physical line the directive governs.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run CRLF typed-JSDoc example and phase/banner exact suffix checks.

reviews.source_analysis: Exact multiword matching excludes conditional/value semantics. The union owner must be unused/unmerged, non-generic and free of dependent this; only broad string is removed while authored null/undefined and literal branches remain.
reviews.concrete_boundary: An observed public interface admitting other string values cannot be narrowed from its comment alone.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run unused versus exported/merged interface union cases and numeric mismatch narration refusals.

reviews.source_analysis: Trailing removal spans originate directly from ESLint UTF-16 token ranges and retain CRLF. Union narrowing rejects escaped literal spellings, computed/indexed/dependent owners and comments inside the changed union before constructing a replacement.
reviews.concrete_boundary: An escaped literal and raw comment spelling may look equal after decoding but cannot share a source-range/literal grammar proof.
reviews.required_new_validation: Probe escaped/non-BMP union members, malformed TS and bare-CR comment boundaries.

reviews.source_analysis: Phase/banner/member comment edits retain line coordinates even when multiple rules target nearby regions. Union narrowing and typed-tag edits change distinct semantic spans and require ESLint fresh reanalysis for any overlap.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A union comment must remain after narrowing; another configured restatement rule must independently prove any later deletion.
reviews.required_new_validation: Compare selected union/tag/comment rules to full configured output and second-pass equality.

reviews.source_analysis: ESLint applies individual callbacks from an original source snapshot, while Standards external execution owns persistence. Native transaction safety does not establish rollback for a TypeScript comment fix combined with native text/YAML edits.
reviews.concrete_boundary: If native YAML changes first and ESLint later fails after modifying TS, both can remain changed in run.
reviews.required_new_validation: Private multi-engine failure witness must record before/after each file and machine stdout separately.

reviews.source_analysis: Banner runs compute adjacency then remap each owned line; typed-tag analysis scans JSDoc blocks. The union helper walks owner AST iteratively to reject dependent this. No benchmark for dense combined comment rules was run.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Thousands of banners beside a large refusing generic union separate comment scanning from type-owner traversal.
reviews.required_new_validation: Five exact-input warm/cold samples are needed before a shared comment index claim.

reviews.source_analysis: The cohort deliberately has two kinds of SAFE work: source-only prose edits and an existing-domain type narrowing proof. Their metadata must describe conditional availability rather than suggesting plain string comments generate domains. Manual oracle/dependency/localization changes remain design work.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Deleting a raw-source test assertion would remove coverage instead of replacing its independent invariant.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run native example verification for all six rules and ensure no-union fixed example retains authored literals/comment.

reviews.source_analysis: Member privacy edits require an unused private class; nominal inheritance repair instead uses an exact closed three-class runtime guard profile, and interface insertion reuses an authored factory type alias. Schema renaming resolves lexical binding references.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A referenced class cannot use the unused-class proof merely because all visible this.member accesses are local.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run five selected positive profiles and live/exported class refusals.

reviews.source_analysis: Private keyword deletion verifies tokens and refuses intervening comments; member keys and all owned references change together. Schema shorthand keys must remain original public property names when their binding is renamed.
reviews.concrete_boundary: { USER_SCHEMA } must become { USER_SCHEMA: UserSchema }, preserving the key as the safe-autofix fixture asserts.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run shorthand/type-query rename fixture and comment-between-private-key refusal.

reviews.source_analysis: Unused bindings plus no heritage/decorators/static/computed execution prevent reflection or class hooks from observing privacy changes. The nominal subset repairs an already-authoritative instanceof contract and never weakens its rejection guard.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Adding extends to a decorated/base-initialized implementation can run new hooks; the complete empty-class profile excludes those cases.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run reflection/static/decorator refusals and nominal before/after runtime TypeError witness.

reviews.source_analysis: Class reference analysis compares compiler symbols rather than spelling, and type-aware owners must match the exact SourceCode revision. UTF-16 native ranges are retained for keys and insertion points; computed/string-key observers are conservative refusals.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A same-spelled external bracket access or Reflect string can observe ordinary private properties even when checker symbols are unavailable.
reviews.required_new_validation: Probe Unicode keys, escaped schema names, unresolved external access and stale TS SourceFile mismatch.

reviews.source_analysis: Privacy conversion groups every key/reference/keyword edit under one diagnostic. Interface/service contract rules can request the same existing implements clause; ESLint reanalysis must deduplicate progress and avoid a duplicate insertion.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Applying an implements insertion twice would produce invalid class syntax; subsequent diagnostics must disappear or remain manual.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run selected/full interface-service combinations, private member rename and second-pass equality.

reviews.source_analysis: Class/profile helpers only return ESLint fixes; their complete-revision source checks precede any output. Standards external formatter persistence remains outside the native transaction and needs the pending write-then-error witness.
reviews.concrete_boundary: An infrastructure error after TypeScript class rewrite cannot be called rolled back solely because native fix_paths uses FileTransaction.
reviews.required_new_validation: Private formatter failure must inspect class source plus any preceding native file changes.

reviews.source_analysis: Private member analysis walks the whole AST recursively for each candidate member, while unused-name detection caches identifier sets by immutable AST. Many members on a deeply nested refusing class are a separate workload from the existing thousand-schema-binding test.
reviews.concrete_boundary: AST depth can stress recursive walk even when same-name reflection ultimately causes refusal.
reviews.required_new_validation: Measure class-member count and AST depth separately; record peak memory and five samples.

reviews.source_analysis: The unused-class guard is shared across both privacy rules and preserves one proof owner. Existing factory/nominal subsets do not invent public interfaces or schemas. Six manual API/UI/test frontiers lack the concrete domain or migration authority recorded separately.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A generic aria-label=Button silences a name check but supplies no useful action name.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run native examples/catalog parity for all five selectors and keep migration compatibility aliases.

reviews.source_analysis: Contradictory/partial predicate repairs replace only an unused private declaration predicate with boolean. Widening/return fixes remove only unused private annotations, and nullish filtering has its own fresh-array native-method proof.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A public isPositive predicate has real false-branch callers; boolean replacement cannot silently migrate them.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run each selected positive with exported/used/overloaded matched refusal.

reviews.source_analysis: Annotation replacement retains every original CR/LF and refuses comments in the span. Named type uses must survive annotation removal, preventing formatter-driven imported-name deletion as an accidental side effect.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A comment inside the type predicate or its last named import reference must block an otherwise unused function fix.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run comment and retained-type-use fixtures with CRLF and multiline predicates.

reviews.source_analysis: Read references, noninitial writes, declaration merges, eslintUsed, exports, declaration files and any eval identifier prevent a private non-observation proof. Nullish filter separately proves no falsy primitive or document.all-compatible domain is removed differently.
reviews.concrete_boundary: filter(Boolean) on number keeps fewer elements than a nullish predicate because 0 is falsy; that type is excluded.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run false-branch runtime witnesses, numeric zero, HTMLAllCollection and namespace mutation refusals.

reviews.source_analysis: Identifier collection is iterative with a WeakSet and immutable-AST WeakMap cache, avoiding parent-cycle recursion. Predicate replacement consumes SourceCode native UTF-16 ranges without converting them to code points.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A non-BMP comment before the annotation shifts UTF-16 offsets differently from code-point offsets.
reviews.required_new_validation: Probe Unicode/escaped identifiers, malformed TS, declaration files and deep AST traversal.

reviews.source_analysis: Boolean predicate repair preserves runtime code but can cause other type diagnostics to disappear or shift; ESLint must reanalyze after applying the replacement. Retained type references protect imports from downstream fixer changes.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A partially narrowed function used by filter cannot be reclassified unused because its caller sits in another scope.
reviews.required_new_validation: Compare partial/contradictory/widening configured fixes and strict compiler output with second-pass equality.

reviews.source_analysis: All annotation fixes are in-memory callbacks. The full pipeline can run native edits before external ESLint; an explicit write-then-fail test is needed before claiming transactional restoration for this cohort.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A failed typed ESLint execution may leave accepted annotation removals written even while reporting infrastructure failure.
reviews.required_new_validation: Record exact file preimages and structured output under private external-fixer failure.

reviews.source_analysis: The shared identifier set is cached once per AST, while type checkers and guard-specific scans may still revisit declarations. The Array predicate helper caches stable variable proofs and defers constructor escape rejection to Program:exit.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Many predicates sharing one Array binding should reuse stability facts, but a late constructor escape must invalidate all pending reports.
reviews.required_new_validation: Measure predicate-count and late-reflection refusal workloads, using five samples before claims.

reviews.source_analysis: One shared private-binding owner protects multiple type fixes; it should not be relaxed just to cover observed predicates. No generic response string, spinner component, refresh source, suppression reason or Zod constructor policy is source-proven for the manual frontier.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Combining Zod literals changes constructor hooks from several schema instances to one even when output values agree.
reviews.required_new_validation: Verify conditional SAFE examples, exact native diagnostics and strict before/after contracts.

reviews.source_analysis: Named callback/return fixes reuse one existing exported context-free alias with exactly matching token structure and lexical binding. Tuple migration uses authored labels plus an existing caller object contract; nominal IDs reuse an existing public overload.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Two equally matching exported aliases provide no unique domain-name authority, so the helper refuses rather than picking the first.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run five selected positive profiles and ambiguous-alias/native tuple refusals.

reviews.source_analysis: Alias matching compares token type/value, while replacement takes the existing raw alias spelling and refuses comments in either structure. Tuple migration groups return type, literal value and destructuring pattern edits.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A meaningful comment inside an anonymous type cannot be silently dropped when replacing it by an alias name.
reviews.required_new_validation: Verify exact untouched source around commented/multiline types and tuple triple-edit output.

reviews.source_analysis: Alias candidates are source-owned exported non-generic type aliases with a unique declaration; scope resolution at the replacement prevents shadow capture. Named-child schema proof separately matches prior module const annotation/factory namespace tokens, retaining actual schema authority.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A local type alias shadow with the same spelling must not capture an existing exported domain name.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run alias shadowing, generic/dependent type refusals and schema namespace rebindings.

reviews.source_analysis: The closed-type grammar permits primitive/literal/union/object/array/readonly forms and excludes context-dependent named references, computed keys and unsupported operators. Raw SourceCode UTF-16 ranges preserve escaped spelling through getText.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A keyof/conditional/generic type can depend on the enclosing scope and cannot be considered token-identical context-free authority.
reviews.required_new_validation: Probe Unicode alias names, deep unions and unsupported dependent types without malformed replacement.

reviews.source_analysis: The alias index is cached by immutable SourceCode; ESLint reanalysis creates a new owner after edits. Existing-type reuse across callback and return diagnostics should converge without creating new declarations or colliding names.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Two simultaneously fixable anonymous contracts must both resolve to the same original alias without stale-cache cross-file reuse.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run combined named callback/return/schema rules and second-pass equality.

reviews.source_analysis: All contract helpers return complete callback edits before ESLint output; tuple migration cannot intentionally persist only its annotation change. External formatter write ownership is outside Standards native transaction and remains a separate pending failure probe.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A write-then-error ESLint phase after native edits may leave tuple caller and unrelated files changed despite status 2.
reviews.required_new_validation: Inject external failure in private multi-engine fixture and inspect each original preimage.

reviews.source_analysis: A WeakMap avoids rebuilding alias signatures per diagnosed annotation. tokenSignature still serializes the target token stream and closedType recursively walks its structure; deep nested arrays/unions are useful refusal/cost inputs.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A large alias set with identical signatures can short-circuit on second visible match, but source size and target depth still differ.
reviews.required_new_validation: Measure alias count, annotation size and ambiguous-match refusal independently with five samples.

reviews.source_analysis: The smallest safe owner reuses authored names/contracts instead of synthesizing domains. Tuple reserved names __proto__/constructor/prototype and public overload identities are separate guards. Manual JSX, log, await, UI and unit-schema decisions remain unproved.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Generating field names from tuple positions would invent a public domain instead of reusing the existing labeled object contract.
reviews.required_new_validation: Verify actual five SAFE examples with native check/fix/check and strict compiler contract parity.

reviews.source_analysis: Minimal consumer edits verify each actual identifier caller against the original parameter type; selector elimination reuses existing literal operations, variant returns are unused-private literal producers, and service contracts reuse an authored direct factory alias.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A previously invalid caller becoming valid can invalidate @ts-expect-error, so the helper refuses sources containing those directives.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run all five selected positives, caller-validity and directive refusals.

reviews.source_analysis: Consumer annotations retain exact CR/LF/U+2028/U+2029 sequences and compare boundary neighbors to prevent forming a new CRLF across a deletion. Comments inside the annotation block repair, and member removals apply in descending source order.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Deleting between a standalone CR and LF can merge two original terminators into one CRLF token.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run terminator-boundary fixtures with CR/LF mixtures, Unicode separators and untouched suffix bytes.

reviews.source_analysis: Caller types must be known and assignable to the original contract, excluding any/unknown/never/generics and unresolved conditional/indexed/substitution forms. Read references must be direct one-argument identifier calls; callback/optional/escaped uses refuse.
reviews.concrete_boundary: An any argument can conceal an originally invalid field contract and cannot prove type-preserving consumer narrowing.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run any/generic/union field caller refusals and direct known-caller positive.

reviews.source_analysis: Removed member ranges must remain inside the annotation, nonempty and ordered without overlap. UTF-16 native source ranges remain authoritative and neighboring terminators are checked before an edit callback exists.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A malformed or stale removal outside the annotation must return null rather than slicing unrelated source.
reviews.required_new_validation: Probe range edges, non-BMP members and overlapping removal inputs with documented native API.

reviews.source_analysis: Removing annotations cannot make named imports/types unused even under simultaneous candidate edits. Shared factory insertion can be offered by several service rules, so ESLint convergence must yield one implements clause.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Two removed type members can collectively erase the last type use even though either deletion alone appears harmless.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run multi-candidate retained-type fixtures and selected/full service rules with strict second-pass equality.

reviews.source_analysis: Consumer/type plans are complete in-memory callbacks; selector deletion pairs all literal caller rewrites and variant narrowing leaves runtime code intact. Standards external ESLint persistence still lacks the native transaction ownership proof.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A tool error after writing an annotation-only fix is not undone by the transaction that finished earlier native edits.
reviews.required_new_validation: Private write-then-failure test must cover native and TypeScript files plus infrastructure status.

reviews.source_analysis: Caller checking collects fields recursively across unions/intersections then inspects every reference. sameLineTerminators scans only a bounded annotation neighborhood. Variant path analysis has explicit visit/object/depth budgets of 2048/256/64.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Many fields across repeated union intersections can dominate caller proof even when no edit survives.
reviews.required_new_validation: Measure caller count versus contract width and budget-limit refusals with five comparable samples.

reviews.source_analysis: The shared contract helper preserves independent caller validity, retained named bindings and physical-line invariants. None should be weakened to cover broad architectural frontend rules; their missing timing, scope, parser and CSS contracts are concrete.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A boolean selector can only disappear when both existing operations and all literal calls are source-owned; arbitrary booleans remain manual.
reviews.required_new_validation: Verify metadata examples and strict/emitted output for all five selectors with canonical formatter sequence.

reviews.source_analysis: Lookup hoisting has one sole exported ordinary function and readonly literal array proof. Other cohort edits are type-import movement, unused ambient enum-to-union, unused literal as-const and ordinary function ordering; every broader declaration finding remains conditional.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Runtime enums cannot use ambient unused enum erasure: emitted enum objects and reverse maps are observable.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run all five selected positives and runtime/const/exported enum refusals.

reviews.source_analysis: Hoisting pairs insertion of the exact existing declaration with removal of its old declaration/trivia span. Comments anywhere refuse. Structure and stepdown also refuse comments rather than moving attached directives/licenses to a different owner.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A comment documenting one local lookup must not be detached and silently moved above another declaration.
reviews.required_new_validation: Verify exact declaration spelling and CRLF output; preserve comment-owned near misses.

reviews.source_analysis: The hoist preserves standard includes values on a readonly literal string array but assumes standard intrinsics; an external delegating Array.prototype.includes observer can see new shared identity. This falls under documented runtime-global replacement limitations and needs an explicit trust-boundary decision, not an automatic defect claim.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Before: two exported calls allocate distinct arrays; after: delegated includes sees the same this array twice.
reviews.required_new_validation: QF-002 should prove actual native fix and classify this against the documented intrinsic trust assumption.

reviews.source_analysis: Only literal string elements and readonly string[] annotations qualify; unsupported/generic/local-dependent data is refused. Native SourceCode UTF-16 ranges are used for moving the original declaration text.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A readonly generic tuple or escaped/synthesized declaration cannot inherit this exact source profile solely by producing equal values.
reviews.required_new_validation: Probe non-BMP literal contents, escaped names and malformed/range-boundary inputs.

reviews.source_analysis: The exact hoist adds a top-level declaration, so the next pass no longer matches the one-statement profile. Type-import and function-order edits must independently rerun diagnostics after movement; as-const should not be redundantly appended.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Running the hoist twice would duplicate the constant; source shape and diagnostic progress must prevent the second offer.
reviews.required_new_validation: Compare selected/full constant/structure/stepdown rules and second-pass equality.

reviews.source_analysis: Hoist insertion and old-local deletion are one callback group. ESLint persistence is external to Standards native FileTransaction, so complete pipeline failure restoration remains a separately designed witness.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A write failure must not leave an exported function referring to an absent hoisted constant; source grouping protects the callback but not tool filesystem failure.
reviews.required_new_validation: Test external formatter write/fail with exact constant-function preimage.

reviews.source_analysis: The closed hoist profile bounds accepted AST shape; detector preanalysis may still scan large functions/constants. Stepdown builds a declaration call graph and may reorder many nodes, while unused binding names are AST-cached.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Many large refusing constant declarations can cost detector work even though only a tiny profile is editable.
reviews.required_new_validation: Measure refusing declaration count and function graph size independently before performance claims.

reviews.source_analysis: Type-only enum/as-const/import edits have different contracts from runtime allocation hoisting. Keep these guards distinct and document the standard-intrinsic assumption. Manual schemas have ordinary constructor hooks, so no similar intrinsic assumption justifies schema reuse.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Zod global postProcessor can observe schema creation count without replacing a native intrinsic.
reviews.required_new_validation: Verify all conditional SAFE examples and retain explicit manual schema/clock/API boundaries.

reviews.source_analysis: JSON equality repair reuses a previously exercised closed comparator for exact string-record literals. Collection property fixes preserve property semantics through Reflect.has, typed reflection only rewrites owned two-argument gets, switch needs terminal branches, and camelcase only unused private type owners.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A Map key-membership .has replacement would change the original in property check; Reflect.has retains property semantics.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run all five selected positives plus Map key/property and reflection receiver near misses.

reviews.source_analysis: JSON comparator repair refuses all source comments and preserves exact object literal text. Reflect.get replacement refuses comments and keeps target/key spelling; switch retains original branch blocks in new lexical braces.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A branch rationale comment or lexical declaration cannot be lost by flattening a switch case body.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run safe-autofix lexical-scope/control-flow fixtures and exact comparator literal suffix checks.

reviews.source_analysis: The comparator domain requires own primitive toJSON data plus the same ordered required string fields, preventing inherited toJSON callbacks without inventing a field. Reflect.get refuses method/tag/delete contexts to avoid changing receiver or lvalue semantics.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Reflect.get(obj, key)() has a detached call receiver; (obj)[key]() would bind this and is refused.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run own-toJSON inherited-hook witness, Proxy has/get parity and detached-call/delete refusals.

reviews.source_analysis: Literal records reject spreads, accessors, shorthand, computed/reserved fields and mismatched order. Native UTF-16 spans are reused; switch requires stable identifiers and refuses unsupported control targets, while camelcase avoids name collisions and dependent this.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A __proto__ object-literal key changes prototype rather than declaring an ordinary compared field.
reviews.required_new_validation: Probe reserved fields, non-BMP values/keys, escaped property names and malformed TS.

reviews.source_analysis: The existing comparator call proves a live authored helper before the equality rewrite adds another use. The helper is never synthesized or renamed, so configured extraction/privacy rules must recompute binding facts after a successful fix.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Deleting the old exercised comparator call would remove the explicit domain authority and should make this profile refuse.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run selected/full comparison/reflection/naming combinations and second-pass equality.

reviews.source_analysis: Each comparison/reflect rewrite is an in-memory callback and all grouped class/name edits precede output. Standards external ESLint writes require the pending whole-pipeline failure witness rather than borrowing native transaction evidence.
reviews.concrete_boundary: An infrastructure failure after a comparator source write can leave a source change even if later tools were stopped.
reviews.required_new_validation: Use private external-fixer write/fail with native and TypeScript preimages recorded.

reviews.source_analysis: Comparator conjunction flattening uses an iterative stack, while type/reflection and switch detector work may depend on union breadth and branch count. Two-statement comparator acceptance is small, but large refusing JSON expressions are separate costs.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Many JSON comparisons inside a module with extra declarations may repeatedly hit source-shape refusal.
reviews.required_new_validation: Benchmark comparison count, record width and branch depth independently with five exact samples.

reviews.source_analysis: The safe owner reuses exact domain authority and the standard JSON intrinsic assumption, preserving property checks instead of guessing collection-key intent. Manual mutation, error serialization, catches, server actions and replay policies need intent.
reviews.concrete_boundary: JSON.stringify(error) to error.message changes response shape and may disclose sensitive detail; equality repair does not authorize it.
reviews.required_new_validation: Verify five actual SAFE examples, selected/default APIs and native parser/formatter convergence.

reviews.source_analysis: UUID repairs reuse an already bound and exercised native provider in a complete UUID-only module.
