Next security properties resolve the effective exported object; static matcher inlines an existing primitive route. Hash repair likewise requires an existing compatible native binding.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A Math.random numeric computation outside the exact UUID recipe does not prove an identifier-generation replacement.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run six native selector positives and non-UUID/random/provider near misses.

reviews.source_analysis: Package UUID replacement groups call replacement with comma-owned v4 import-specifier removal while retaining NIL import and module initialization. Matcher pairs existing declaration deletion with literal insertion; whole-source comments refuse both profiles.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Removing the entire uuid import would remove NIL and potentially import initialization effects.
reviews.required_new_validation: Verify import comma positions, aliases, CRLF and exact retained NIL/export output.

reviews.source_analysis: crypto.randomUUID.bind(crypto) must use unshadowed global receiver and argument; helper reads resolve exact bindings. Config changes require effective last property and reject explicit TS/JSDoc type contracts that require literal true.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A source annotation such as { productionBrowserSourceMaps: true } would become invalid if blindly fixed to false.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run shadowed crypto, binding aliases and constrained Next config refusals.

reviews.source_analysis: UUID recipe matches exact template, regex, parameter binding and callback token structure. Static matcher/config helpers use native UTF-16 ranges and bounded declaration counts; no offset is computed from decoded runtime string content.
reviews.concrete_boundary: An escaped UUID template or different random-digit callback cannot be accepted by a name-only heuristic.
reviews.required_new_validation: Probe non-BMP preceding source, escaped literal spellings and malformed provider recipes.

reviews.source_analysis: UUID package repair retains native, legacy and NIL exported results; the next pass sees no flagged legacy call and cannot remove the remaining import. Config literal false/inline matcher edits independently converge under ESLint diagnostics.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A configured UUID/provider fixer must not reinsert a removed v4 name or duplicate native provider bindings.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run selected/full UUID/hash/config rules and verify second-pass exact output.

reviews.source_analysis: The UUID call/import and matcher declaration/use edits are source-only groups. External ESLint persistence follows Standards native plans without shared rollback ownership, so full-pipeline write failure remains pending.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Failure while persisting a paired import/call plan must not be reported as native transaction restoration without inspecting the file.
reviews.required_new_validation: Use external write/fail fixture and record retained imports, source preimages and infrastructure status.

reviews.source_analysis: Complete-module statement counts bound accepted UUID work; recipe token signatures and lexical lookup scans are local. Config resolution has cycle detection but may walk alias chains; hashing candidates perform namespace analysis before fixes.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Many refusing random calls in a larger module can repeatedly fail the whole-module check cheaply; alias-chain depth is a separate axis.
reviews.required_new_validation: Measure candidate count and config alias depth with five samples, no unmeasured speed claim.

reviews.source_analysis: Existing-provider reuse avoids new imports or selection of random/hash intent. Next literal hardening is guarded against declared incompatible types. Manual browser storage, Zod, fetch/filesystem and SVG/UI decisions require runtime or user-facing contracts.
reviews.concrete_boundary: document.cookie cannot install HttpOnly storage from JavaScript, so rewriting localStorage to a cookie is not a safe credential repair.
reviews.required_new_validation: Verify six conditional SAFE examples and provider/runtime/strict compiler boundaries.

reviews.source_analysis: Repeated string fixes reuse an existing primitive const in a complete declaration-only module. Literal string loops and identity reducers have closed profiles; SQL star expansion owns a bounded literal relation and default pg consumer. Conditional spread needs its own effect-preserving branch proof.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Extracting an arbitrary repeated object/string expression into a new binding would invent lifetime and naming authority.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run all five selected positives and dynamic/escaped source ownership refusals.

reviews.source_analysis: String replacement preserves only owned literal spans and the existing raw constant name; comments cause refusal. SQL projection changes one star in an unescaped ASCII single-quoted literal, preserving every unrelated query/source byte.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A backslash-escaped SQL literal has decoded offsets different from raw TS and cannot share the ASCII query proof.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run exact owned-SQL projection suffix tests plus CRLF string/loop source checks.

reviews.source_analysis: Every repeated-string occurrence is a sole primitive return with resolved constant binding; prior live constant use proves existing authority. Identity reduce returns a fresh literal array while string loop has no intermediate observers under standard intrinsic assumptions.
reviews.concrete_boundary: An effectful reducer, custom iterable or exposed intermediate accumulator invalidates the identity/closed-loop proof.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run runtime effect/order near misses and existing primitive-string binding positives.

reviews.source_analysis: Plans are cached per immutable SourceCode and store actual literal nodes; lookup checks both runtime literal value and lexical binding. SQL projection caps 2,048 characters/eight values and bounded quoted labels before calculating a star range.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A stale plan from a different AST must not match a structurally equal literal node in another file.
reviews.required_new_validation: Probe Unicode constants, escaped strings, maximum query width and malformed projection inputs.

reviews.source_analysis: The existing constant remains live before and after replacement, avoiding import/name-lifetime churn. Loop conversion groups initializer, let-to-const and loop removal; identity reduction and spread simplification require fresh native diagnostics after any overlapping edit.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Partial loop rewrite could return an array instead of a string; the group must be accepted as one candidate.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run combined literal/iteration/spread rules and configured second-pass equality.

reviews.source_analysis: Literal and SQL transformations return complete source callbacks. Standards can plan native SQL alongside external TS fixes but only native writes have FileTransaction ownership; external failure restoration needs its own evidence.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A later external failure must not be called all-or-nothing just because standalone SQL planning is transactional.
reviews.required_new_validation: Private multi-engine write/fail witness must compare source bytes for each engine.

reviews.source_analysis: WeakMap plan reuse prevents a whole-module scan per repeated string; literal loop/reduce helpers reject mismatched source shape early. SQL regex grammar is length/field bounded, while source scanner costs can still scale with diagnostics.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Large refusing SQL text must stop before unbounded projection expansion; many repeated literals share one immutable plan.
reviews.required_new_validation: Measure literal count and query length independently with exact digests and five samples.

reviews.source_analysis: Existing primitive authority is smaller and safer than generating constants; no new field/import/domain name is invented. Six manual test, storage, bound and pagination frontiers lack expected domain, durability or lifecycle decisions.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Removing OFFSET repeats page one and does not produce a valid stable cursor.
reviews.required_new_validation: Verify five real SAFE fixed examples with runtime/strict contract and formatter convergence.

reviews.source_analysis: Optional-array simplification requires exact zod/v3 import and one unused private schema, avoiding Zod 4 constructor hooks. Consumer union/nonnullable changes use closed caller/private proofs; infer/output replacements require actual authoritative schema/native contract evidence.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A Zod 4 optional wrapper can invoke configured constructor hooks even when its output type is identical.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run five selected positive profiles and Zod 4/observed-schema refusals.

reviews.source_analysis: Wrapper replacement retains the original array call text and requires no comments. Consumer annotation helpers retain physical terminators; inferred/output aliases replace only owned type spans with retained named bindings.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A rationale comment inside optional/default chain must not disappear with the wrapper.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run comment-protected wrapper and CRLF/Unicode-separator type-span fixtures.

reviews.source_analysis: The schema import binding must have exactly the two proven array/string references, no escapes or rebindings; the declaration must be unused private. The v3-only boundary cannot be generalized from value/type equality to v4 ordinary hooks.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Passing z or the schema to another function invalidates source-owned non-observation even if the parse output stays equal.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run namespace escape, schema read and imported-provider lookalike refusals.

reviews.source_analysis: Optional calls, computed properties, extra arguments and type arguments refuse the closed chain. AST-native UTF-16 ranges avoid runtime string offset conversion; consumer deletion has separate terminator boundary checks.
reviews.concrete_boundary: array().optional?.() or a dynamic property cannot be treated as the same native chain.
reviews.required_new_validation: Probe malformed/optional/computed chains and non-BMP prior text.

reviews.source_analysis: The optional wrapper disappears only once; retained default and array behavior are rechecked by the native rule. infer and parse-output rules have separate precedence/ownership so one declaration should not receive incompatible inferred aliases.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Two annotations that witness each other's last named import use must not both disappear under simultaneous fixing.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run configured Zod/consumer rules with retained-type simultaneous cases and second-pass equality.

reviews.source_analysis: Zod/type fixes stay in memory; no constructor executes during source fixing. The external typed ESLint step persists results outside Standards native transaction, so write/failure isolation needs direct evidence.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A native transaction receipt alone cannot prove that a later TypeScript schema write is restored on infrastructure failure.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run private external write-then-error fixture with exact schema preimage.

reviews.source_analysis: The v3 profile is constant-size and rejects extra statements before walking chains. Full infer/output detectors build schema/contract maps and can scale with declarations and candidate pairs; source-owned caches must not survive a new AST revision.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Many unrelated schema twins may stress candidate matching without any accepted wrapper edit.
reviews.required_new_validation: Measure schema-count and contract-width axes with five samples and exact source digests.

reviews.source_analysis: Provider-version specificity is an essential semantic guard, not duplication to remove. Broader custom parsers, shared schemas, expected assertions and form defaults need domain/constructor/UI policy; no new diagnosed subset was established.
reviews.concrete_boundary: An empty-string form default is wrong for boolean, numeric, nullable or server-initialized fields.
reviews.required_new_validation: Verify native examples/catalog version boundary and strict before/after contract checks.

reviews.source_analysis: Detached fetch repair owns one unescaped object and one literal data: request; overload correction owns unused complete overload declarations, assertion casts only unused runtime-preserving expressions, and assertNever reuses an existing no-op guard.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A network URL with options or an escaping stored fetch callback cannot inherit the one literal data request proof.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run five selected positives plus escaping fetch and public-overload refusals.

reviews.source_analysis: Shorthand storage becomes key: fetch.bind(undefined), retaining the original key. Cast removal retains runtime expression text and refuses comments; overload edits retain physical newlines and never alter implementation source.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Replacing { fetch } by just fetch.bind would change object property structure; owned key expansion preserves it.
reviews.required_new_validation: Verify exact shorthand/key spelling, CRLF cast spans and commented overload refusal.

reviews.source_analysis: The object binding must resolve to its declaration and have only initialization plus the one receiver read. Global fetch/undefined must be unshadowed. Assertion fixes require independently retained exported type uses, avoiding erasing mock imports or changing evaluation.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A contextual arrow/generic mock assertion can affect inference even though casts erase at runtime and therefore remains manual.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run contextual/generic/mock provider near misses and owned data-fetch runtime checks.

reviews.source_analysis: The owner has no parameters, type arguments, optional chains or declared return type; unsafe __proto__ keys are refused. Native UTF-16 spans and parser token ranges own all edits, with no guessed source coordinate conversion.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A computed unknown key or a second object use breaks the complete sole-request profile.
reviews.required_new_validation: Probe Unicode key spelling, malformed optional calls and source range/EOF boundaries.

reviews.source_analysis: Fetch binding repair resolves one diagnostic and cannot bind an already bound value again. Overload fixes group only mismatching annotations, while assertNever keeps unexpected-value behavior by calling an already authored empty function.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Adding a new throwing assertNever would change out-of-domain runtime behavior; the no-op existing helper is essential.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run selected/full assertion/fetch/overload rules and second-pass equality under strict checking.

reviews.source_analysis: These callbacks finish before ESLint persists the complete string; grouped overload annotations cannot intentionally publish partial source. External formatter filesystem ownership remains distinct from Standards native rollback.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A later tool status 2 after a fetch rewrite must report changed source accurately and cannot imply the write was reverted.
reviews.required_new_validation: Private write/fail fixture should inspect final source and structured status/output.

reviews.source_analysis: The fetch owner is constant-size and reference-list checks are linear in its tiny profile. Overload/type assertion detectors can inspect broader programs; direct result syntax caps union branches before constructing types.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Many unrelated overloads and type references may dominate detection despite the fixed subset staying unused/private.
reviews.required_new_validation: Measure overload-count and nested-type-depth refusal workloads with five samples.

reviews.source_analysis: The implementation repairs exact diagnosed binding/narrowing problems with existing authority and keeps direct native compatibility. Bare test catch, module mock, raw fetch, translation and timeout changes lack expected error/client/lifetime policy.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Adding an invented AbortSignal.timeout duration can abort valid work or leave cleanup unowned.
reviews.required_new_validation: Verify every actual SAFE fixed example and remaining manual diagnostics through native formatter/recheck.

reviews.source_analysis: Only six registered selected SQL rules dispatch after unknown-rule validation and PostgreSQL parseability checks. DDL guards match actual diagnostic lines and statement starts; literal conversions require catalog-qualified closed expressions, while comments need owned standalone diagnostics.
reviews.concrete_boundary: CREATE inside a dollar-quoted body/string must not receive an existence guard from a textual match.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run six native fixed examples and dollar-body/stale-location refusal cases.

reviews.source_analysis: Comment removal preserves every physical CR/LF and refuses directives, licenses, references and rollback prose. Disabled SQL requires a complete semicolon-terminated supported statement run; banner lines are independently removable only when pure decoration.
reviews.concrete_boundary: -- Rollback: DROP TABLE users is operational guidance rather than disabled forward SQL.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run authored rollback/reference/literal-region fixtures and exact LF/CRLF output.

reviews.source_analysis: DDL guard insertion respects INDEX CONCURRENTLY placement. Literal repair does not alter arbitrary VARCHAR/JSON/TIMESTAMP columns: bounded varchar is already cast outward to text; JSON empty literal is already cast to JSONB; timestamp needs an explicit zero-offset owner.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Changing naive TIMESTAMP generally needs timezone policy; session-dependent conversion is excluded.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run catalog/user-type, invalid date, bound/truncation and timezone matched refusals.

reviews.source_analysis: Unsupported Command ASTs, malformed parse and RecursionError retain original source before editing. Physical source-location ownership avoids nonphysical splitlines confusion; literal spans cross-check parser metadata against exact raw ASCII spelling and native type structure.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A string whose decoded SQLGlot value differs from its raw quoted slice cannot own an edit offset.
reviews.required_new_validation: Probe Unicode before casts, malformed comments, bare CR, escaped literals and incomplete ranges.

reviews.source_analysis: All selected edits share original offsets; shared apply_edits deduplicates exact edits and refuses conflicting ranges. Comment/banner overlapping groups converge in one application as authored; literal and DDL choices require final parseability before return.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Selecting narration and cruft together must not apply the same disabled block twice.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run selected-order combinations, existing one-application banner tests and fix(fix(source)) equality.

reviews.source_analysis: SQL planning returns a complete source or original; shared fix_file owns single-file snapshot/temp fsync/mode/group and Standards _plan computes all native engines before transactional writes. No migration executes during fixing.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A later native plan error after an accepted SQL guard insertion must occur before any selected source is written.
reviews.required_new_validation: Inject plan/write/fsync failures with a multi-engine selected SQL candidate and verify rollback ownership.

reviews.source_analysis: Each diagnostic may expand to its entire adjacent standalone comment run, repeating scans before deduplication. Literal conversions reparse once per selected literal rule; parse/refusal work needs measurement before caching changes.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A long disabled block with many diagnostics can revisit the same paragraph and produce duplicate edit proposals.
reviews.required_new_validation: Measure comment diagnostics and SQL length independently with five cold/warm samples.

reviews.source_analysis: The small SQL owner keeps grammar, coordinate and operational protections independent. Fourteen manual frontiers need deployment/schema/transaction decisions; duplicate-name replay already excluded by detectors cannot be repackaged as a new SAFE subset.
reviews.concrete_boundary: An apparently duplicate index can own a constraint, replica identity or later migration name even when key signatures match.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run all six actual examples, native PostgreSQL/formatter convergence and exact manual diagnostics.

reviews.source_analysis: Five selected IaC rules dispatch only after suffix/fixture/generated/parse-structure guards and actual native diagnostics. Conditional reduction owns top-level locals and same-kind literal arms; validation and terraform_data removal require exact diagnosed block ownership.
reviews.concrete_boundary: An environment condition is not a literal boolean condition even when both text arms look equal.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run five native fixed examples and literal/environment matched near misses.

reviews.source_analysis: Comment/assertion deletion blanks text while preserving each physical ending. Protected directives and heredoc body ownership prevent content deletion; disabled HCL requires a complete balanced code-only run so nearby rationale remains.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A disabled resource run followed by a prose explanation cannot be deleted as one code block.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run exact LF/CRLF comment fixtures, heredoc/trailing token and license/rationale refusals.

reviews.source_analysis: Removed assertions must contain only condition and a literal error_message, no nested blocks/comments, and full own-line braces. Literal-conditional folding evaluates both arm kinds and forbids template interpolation, preserving HCL coercion/error semantics.
reviews.concrete_boundary: true ? 1 : "1" is a mixed-kind conditional whose result type cannot be inferred by simply choosing the true arm.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run real Terraform value/type cases for literal and nullable validation boundaries.

reviews.source_analysis: HCL tokenization and document validation reject unbalanced delimiters, duplicate attributes and empty values. Conditional parser bounds expression length/tokens/depth/numeric exponent and validates exact target structural delta after replacement.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A balanced but duplicate-attribute input must not be treated as a valid editable HCL document.
reviews.required_new_validation: Probe duplicate attributes, non-BMP prefixes, bare CR, escaped/template literals and limits ±1.

reviews.source_analysis: Comment edits first prove native token equality before joining structural edits. _nonoverlapping deduplicates/suppresses nested ranges, while literal conditional edits have one target delta each; configured second pass must resolve any deferred overlapping structure.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A removed validation block containing a comment candidate must not apply an inner stale-range deletion as well.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run combined comment/validation/literal rules, token parity and second-pass equality.

reviews.source_analysis: IaC transformation remains in memory until balanced final output passes; native file writer and Standards transaction own persistence. No Terraform plan/apply or IAM operation occurs in a fixer.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A later selected SQL failure must not leave the first IaC validation block already deleted.
reviews.required_new_validation: Use private selected multi-engine plan/write failure and shared temp-fsync ownership tests.

reviews.source_analysis: Each selected rule and assertion helper can parse document/source repeatedly; literal conditional target-delta verification reparses per accepted attribute. Explicit 256-token/32-depth/16,384-character limits bound one expression, but candidate count still scales.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Many small accepted locals can trigger repeated whole-document equality checks.
reviews.required_new_validation: Measure attribute count and expression depth separately with five exact baseline/candidate samples.

reviews.source_analysis: The native proof keeps literal conditional evaluation separate from terraform_data/validation removal and exact token-preserving comments. Nine manual cloud/IAM/environment frontiers need external ownership/trust; no keys, permissions, guards or oracles can be invented.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Even terraform.workspace may be invalid in some evaluator contexts, so folding its equal arms can hide a required diagnostic.
reviews.required_new_validation: Verify conditional SAFE examples against actual native Terraform parser/value/type checks and all manual keys.

reviews.source_analysis: Five selected text rules honor unknown selectors, policy exclusions and native diagnostic ownership. CloudBuild repair narrows only duplicate all-dash flow waitFor lists and verifies the exact parsed-value plus diagnostic multiset delta; comment edits require existing findings.
reviews.concrete_boundary: waitFor ["-", "build"] has conflicting actual dependencies and cannot be fixed by guessing which to retain.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run five native fixed examples and mixed/unreported CloudBuild near misses.

reviews.source_analysis: Text deletion retains all original physical CR/LF. Markdown requires one balanced hidden comment and plain context; YAML/TOML comment edits reparse and require equal values. CloudBuild retains list whitespace/endings and refuses comments/anchors/tags/merge ambiguity.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A # line in a YAML block scalar is data, not a removable config comment.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run authored scalar/frontmatter/template/fenced HTML and exact CRLF hidden-heading cases.

reviews.source_analysis: Exclusions and generated ownership precede edits. Markdown MDX/frontmatter/raw HTML/templates/multiline inline-code are refused; config equality proves comment-only semantics, while CloudBuild changes only the already invalid duplicate start sentinel.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Removing a hidden heading inside a textarea/script/template can change literal payload rather than hidden documentation.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run test_uncertain_literal_generated_and_suppressed_text_is_preserved and native CloudBuild expected-delta cases.

reviews.source_analysis: YAML uses its native splitlines coordinate convention, TOML LF-only physical buffers and Markdown explicit physical lines; the choice is path-specific. Strict JSON CloudBuild parsing does not silently reinterpret invalid JSON as YAML.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A JSON tab-indentation form rejected by the native boundary must stay rejected even when YAML would parse it.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run JSON native-refusal, BOM/non-BMP, Unicode separator and TOML literal-newline cases.

reviews.source_analysis: Comment edits apply first, then CloudBuild reanalyzes the resulting source and checks exact diagnostic subtraction. Identical comment edits deduplicate; indentation-separated disabled groups must remain nonoverlapping and independent.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Two adjacent disabled config groups with different indentation must not generate overlapping source ranges.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run authored adjacent-group and sentinel/comment combined tests with selected-order/idempotence checks.

reviews.source_analysis: Text source repairs parse and validate in memory before the common native transaction captures final bytes. Standards plans YAML with other native engines before first write and rollback restores only owned source revisions.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A late second-file write failure must restore an earlier changed CloudBuild list while preserving a concurrently edited unrelated file.
reviews.required_new_validation: Run native multi-engine write/fsync/rollback fixtures with exact YAML before/after values and structured stdout.

reviews.source_analysis: Comment findings collect attached comments once but per-wall grouping can repeat source-line scans; Markdown plain-context/prose checks and CloudBuild native parse/delta checks add full-source passes. No measured optimization claim is made.
reviews.concrete_boundary: A large YAML file with many short wall findings can amplify repeated grouping despite all comments preserving values.
reviews.required_new_validation: Measure wall count, source length and refusing YAML alias cases independently with five samples.

reviews.source_analysis: The owner keeps parser-value equality, physical trivia and plain-Markdown authority independent. Seven manual deployment/artifact/oracle/shell/query/approval frontiers need durable facts, grammar or user policy; source cleanup cannot silently perform those migrations.
reviews.concrete_boundary: Removing a wildcard secret-read permission edits intentional approval policy and cannot be inferred from diagnostic presence alone.
reviews.required_new_validation: Verify actual five SAFE examples, exclusions/public APIs and native formatting/recheck semantics.
